heading: About
paragraphs: I build production software end to end — backend architecture, RAG pipelines and the interfaces on top of them. Transinaut, a customs classification SaaS I designed and shipped alone, runs in production today at www.transinaut.com. Alongside it I co-built Chronicler, an offline-capable document assistant, with a team of three.
Currently a Master's student in Information Systems Engineering & Artificial Intelligence at ESISA, Fez. Seeking a software development internship.
